summary: Pellerin publicly declared solidarity with Israel and JPAC after Oct 7, calling Hamas actions 'terrorist attacks' and praying for hostage release and peace.
quote: I stand in solidarity with our nation's leaders, my colleagues in the CA Legislature, & @JPAC in support of Israel. I pray for the safe release of the hostages, & I pray for peace.

summary: Pellerin signed a 5-page Jewish Caucus letter to colleagues asking for 'support and solidarity' after Oct 7, expressing personal trauma and feeling of abandonment.
quote: It has impacted many of us on a deeply personal level, and we find ourselves asking fundamental questions — including about the security of our families and our community
